description: This source file defines serializers and copiers for the `object` type within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes classes ObjectCodec and ObjectCopier, which handle serialization, deserialization, and deep copying of `object` instances, integrating with Orleans' type and reference management systems.

classes.name: ObjectCodec
classes.description: Serializer class for handling serialization and deserialization of the `object` type in Orleans serialization system.

classes.name: ObjectCopier
classes.description: Copier class responsible for deep copying `object` instances within Orleans.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value from the input using the appropriate serializer based on the field type or reference.

methods.name: ReadObject
methods.description: Reads an untyped object, ensuring wire type correctness, and records the object for reference tracking.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes an object value, selecting the correct serializer, and handling null references.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the input object, utilizing the copy context to avoid duplication.
